name: io.github.SutramX/mcp-server
title: SutramX
description: SutramX uptime monitoring: monitors, check results, incidents, status pages and uptime/SLO reports.

environmentVariables.name: SUTRAMX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SutramX workspace API key (sk_...), from Settings > API keys. A Read-only key is recommended for agents.

environmentVariables.name: SUTRAMX_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL; https only. Change it only for staging or self-hosted installs.

environmentVariables.name: SUTRAMX_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: true also registers the permanent delete tools (monitors, status pages).
